recommendation: Keep the no-change audit as-is. No core FHIR source follow-up is needed for FHIR-27868 unless OO decides in a future tracker to reintroduce a separate performerType element or revise the current CodeableReference modeling.
issue_request: FHIR-27868 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution for R5. It asked to replace the copied DiagnosticRequest wording on DeviceRequest.performer and, after OO discussion, to update DeviceRequest.performer, DeviceRequest.performerType, and DeviceRequest.requester so requester identifies who submitted or initiated the request while performer/performerType identify the individual, entity, or category providing the requested device.
initial_application: Commit 0763661ef79399537866358e94efadccc2577c4a ("27868 25799") changed source/devicerequest/structuredefinition-DeviceRequest.xml on 2021-04-04, replacing the requester short/definition, performerType definition, and performer definition with the requested language. Commit 086649a2357c29f8c83dca7604dc592d32c84355 later added the DeviceRequest request-pattern mapping exception file with the same current requester and performer wording.
additional_context: DeviceRequest is active in source/fhir.ini. The current source no longer has DeviceRequest.performerType as a separate element; later R6 cleanup removed the commented performerType element after performer became the CodeableReference surface, and source/fhir.ini records DeviceRequest.performerType as mapped to performer.concept. OO HCP minutes from 2020-07-27 record the same proposed updates; no directly relevant Zulip conflict was found. FHIR-25799 appeared in the same historical commit subject and minutes but concerns DeviceUseStatement, so it was treated as background only.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was necessary because the current build source already carries the required DeviceRequest requester and performer wording, and the performerType part of the historical resolution is represented by the later merged performer CodeableReference model/migration note rather than by a current separate element.

related_jiras.note: It appeared in the same 2021 commit subject and 2020 OO HCP minutes, but it concerns DeviceUseStatement Device/DeviceDefinition semantics rather than the DeviceRequest requester/performer wording decided here.
